name: Hyundai South Africa
role: Official vehicle sponsor, 18th South African Sport Awards
body: Creating opportunities for the brand to connect with audiences through memorable event experiences and strategic brand integration. We worked with Hyundai South Africa as the official vehicle sponsor for the 18th Edition of the South African Sport Awards

name: South African Sport Awards
body: Supporting one of South Africa’s premier celebrations of sporting excellence, connecting brands with athletes, sporting personalities, stakeholders and passionate audiences. We brought various brands that align with the event, such as Hyundai, Icebolethu Funerals, African Bank to name just a few

name: African Bank
body: Developing partnership opportunities that allow the brand to engage audiences through purposeful, professionally executed experiences.
